rows.label: Product Setting
rows.description:
#### SKU Number Prefix

* A text string placed at the beginning of your Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) to help create a unique identifier for each product.
* Enter a concise text string (e.g., **SKU** or **PROD**).
* Use alphanumeric characters along with hyphens or underscores if needed.

#### SKU Current Number

* The sequential numeric value that represents the current count of products, forming part of the SKU.
* Enter a numeric value (e.g., **5**, **12**, **1000**).
* Use only digits; **avoid** use zero **(0)** starting of the SKU Current Number. (e.g., **0005**, **0012**)

#### SKU Number Postfix

* A text string appended to the SKU, used for additional categorization or differentiation.
* Enter a short text string (e.g., **A** or **US**)
* Keep the text simple and avoid spaces or unsupported special characters.
